title: 再生能源併網保護
summary: 以併網邊界、故障穿越與孤島辨識串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect interconnection boundaries, ride-through and island detection through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

stages.title: 要求與模型
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「要求與模型」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop requirements and models through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 連接點：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「連接點」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for connection point.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「連接點」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。合規量測位置需與設備端分清。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「標示變壓器及線路壓降。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for connection point, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Compliance measurement points may differ from device terminals. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Mark transformer and line drops. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 標示變壓器及線路壓降。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「連接點」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping connection point verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「連接點」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「標示變壓器及線路壓降。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for connection point; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 合規量測位置需與設備端分清。
knowledge.textEn: Compliance measurement points may differ from device terminals.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 標示變壓器及線路壓降。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Mark transformer and line drops. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設 1 MVA 逆變器、線電壓 400 V，額定 I=S/(√3V)=1443.4 A。若短時限流為假設的 1.2 pu，短時 RMS 電流上限 1732.1 A；這不是實際產品或標準限值。
knowledge.textEn: For an assumed 1 MVA inverter at line voltage 400 V, rated I=S/(√3V)=1443.4 A. An illustrative 1.2 pu short-term RMS limit is 1732.1 A, not a product or standards limit.

quiz.question: 審查「連接點」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for connection point?
options: 合規量測位置需與設備端分清。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「連接點」的驗證。
只調整「連接點」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Compliance measurement points may differ from device terminals.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping connection point verification.
Tuning the displayed connection point result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 合規量測位置需與設備端分清。 標示變壓器及線路壓降。
quiz.explanationEn: Compliance measurement points may differ from device terminals. Mark transformer and line drops.

steps.title: 連接點：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「連接點」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for connection point.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。標示變壓器及線路壓降。 比較差異是否符合「合規量測位置需與設備端分清。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Mark transformer and line drops. Compare the result against: Compliance measurement points may differ from device terminals. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 標示變壓器及線路壓降。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「連接點」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping connection point verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「連接點」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for connection point; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.
